messages:
amy_sales: Quick sync — FinCo POC: they require BYO KMS with HSM-backed keys, rotation policy, cross-region replication, and attestation. They want a 6-week POC and a quote. Any blockers for hosted vs private?
jordan_se: clarifying q's: do they want keys in their cloud account (CMEK/CloudHSM) or an external HSM we talk to? which cloud? AWS/GCP/Azure? also do they need key import vs generated-in-HSM?
finco_sec: we can provide AWS CloudHSM cluster in our account, attestation certs, and will allow role-based access. prefer keys generated in the HSM and never exported.
miles_sec: security checklist reminder: must ensure key material never leaves customer HSM, FIPS 140-2/3 level requirement, attestation cert (CSR + APT timestamp), key usage restrictions (sign/encrypt), rotation window (we need to know allowed grace period), and audit log retention (we require xfer logs for 1 year). please confirm.
tara_legal: heads up — if keys are customer-managed we need to update SOW: liability for key compromise, SLA carveouts for BYOK, and explicit acceptance criteria for POC. I'll need the customer's MSA or a draft to attach.
ops_engineer: engineering notes: hosted Redwood API cannot reach customer CloudHSM inside their VPC. Options: 1) Envelope encryption where we call customer KMS API (CMEK) — supported for AWS KMS and GCP CMEK in hosted mode; 2) Private deployment / VPC connector for direct CloudHSM/PKCS#11 access; 3) Bring connector VM that tunnels (more manual, higher ops). Example connector config we'll use:```yaml
kms_connector:
  provider: aws
  role_arn: arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNTID:role/RedwoodKmsConnector
  cloudhsm_cluster: cluster-abc123
  pkcs11_slot: 0
  kms_mode: envelope
```
ops_engineer: note: direct CloudHSM-backed keys (generated in HSM) require Private deployment or a customer-exposed endpoint we can route to — leads to higher onboarding time (~2-4 weeks) and likely a one-time engineering fee.
devops_bot: Created ticket SALES-4321: BYO-KMS POC scoping (assigned: jordan_se) :white_check_mark:
amy_sales: Jordan — can you give a rough pricing delta (onboarding fee, monthly connector fee, private deploy surcharge) so I can prep the commercial? Also need line items for SOW (attestation review, connector infra, 24/7 on-call for POC).
jordan_se: Rough numbers for initial planning: one-time onboarding eng fee $18k (connector + testing + attestation ops), monthly connector/monitoring $3k/mo, private deployment surcharge (if needed) $12k/mo for reserved capacity + infra. If customer keeps keys in our hosted flow (CMEK only) it's cheaper: $6k onboarding + $1.2k/mo. These are estimates — will confirm after infra scoping.
miles_sec: add security review cost/time — we typically need 3 business days to review attestation docs and 5 business days for pen-test scheduling if requested. Also need confirmation they will share CloudHSM attestation (certificate) and rotation policy.
finco_sec: we can provide attestation PDFs and the CloudHSM cluster ARN. Pen-test we may need to coordinate with our security team — happy to schedule.
jordan_se: next steps I propose: 1) 30-min technical call w/ FinCo ops + our infra + security (share connector config); 2) collect attestation + CloudHSM details + allowed rotation grace; 3) decide hosted-envelope vs private deployment; 4) draft SOW + commercial (I'll loop Tara for legal). Can we get the call this week?
tara_legal: I'll prep a POC SOW template with BYOK clauses and a short indemnity paragraph — will send redline to Amy once I have the customer's MSA.
amy_sales: I'll schedule the call and add the checklist above. tagging @jordan_se @miles_sec @tara_legal — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
